muc.title: Real photo, old story
muc.text: Many shocking photos aren't fake. They are real photos of an old story pinned on a new event.

muc.title: Where has this photo been
muc.text: Use an image search tool to see where the photo has appeared before and when it first showed up.

muc.title: AI spots the details
muc.text: Send the photo to a chatbot and ask it to list details like shop signs, weather, car models or text on shirts.

muc.title: Match it to the story
muc.text: Compare those details with the story attached. AI can guess the place wrong, so treat it only as a lead to keep checking.

muc.title: Trace a hot photo
muc.text: Pick a photo that's going viral, run a reverse image search, then ask AI to list its details.
